messages:
emma: Quick brainstorm: "Starter Ignite" launch to drive community contributions to our OSS refapp and capture demo leads. Short webinar + repo sprint, 30-45m. :sparkles:
chris: Love the name. Goals?
emma: Targets: 600 repo clones, 90 webinar regs, 18 demo-qualified leads.
nina: Tutorial idea: 4 bite-sized tasks (clone, run, swap model, run embed job). Each <15m. Include a perf script.
oscar: I'll draft a tiny perf helper for README. Example: `python bench.py --model rdx-lite-q4 --prompt "hello"`
chris: Messaging: keep it dev-first — "Build and benchmark a live LLM demo in under an hour". Add a short benchmark box comparing local quantized vs hosted.
emma: Webinar: 35m hands-on + 10m Q&A. Proposed Thu May 6 11am PT. @oscar you good to run infra demo?
oscar: Yup. I'll show a graceful fallback to a smaller variant and a quick deploy to sandbox.
bot-campaigns: campaign created: starter-ignite, landing draft: https://redwood.example/starter-ignite (owner: emma)
emma: Action items: emma -> blog + landing copy (Tue), nina -> tutorial steps + prework README (Wed), chris -> social hooks + email cadence (Wed), oscar -> perf script + dry run (Wed). Dry run Fri 10am PT. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
